reason: S1 adds a new public comparison/search API surface whose behavior H0 does not invoke. The two H0 targets only pass fuzzer bytes to plist_from_bin or plist_from_xml and then call plist_free; they never call the new helpers or provide their independent cmpval, n, substr, cmpsec, or cmpusec inputs. Consequently H0 cannot directly exercise comparison-length semantics or the new memmem-backed data search. This gap did not exist in S0 because none of these declarations or implementations existed there, so the commit introduced it.
evidence: include/plist/plist.h newly declares comparison and containment entry points including plist_string_val_compare_with_size, plist_data_val_compare_with_size, and plist_data_val_contains.
src/plist.c newly implements helpers using strcmp, strncmp, strstr, memcmp, and memmem with caller-controlled comparison values and sizes.
src/plist.c newly adds the fallback memmem implementation reached by plist_data_val_contains when HAVE_MEMMEM is absent.
fuzz/bplist_fuzzer.cc invokes only plist_from_bin(data, size, &root_node) followed by plist_free(root_node).
fuzz/xplist_fuzzer.cc invokes only plist_from_xml(data, size, &root_node) followed by plist_free(root_node).
The S0 declaration context explicitly reports no matching declaration, while S1 exposes the new helpers.
The header declares plist_bool_val_is_true whereas src/plist.c defines plist_boolean_is_true; neither identity is exercised by H0.
recommended_action: Extend or add a structure-aware harness that parses or constructs nodes of each relevant PLIST type, invokes the new comparison and containment APIs, and derives comparison buffers, lengths, substrings, numeric values, and dates from fuzz input; include coverage of plist_data_val_contains and its fallback memmem path.
